parameters.query: select coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object('platform', platform, 'external_id', external_id, 'thumbnail_url', thumbnail_url, 'hero_mp4_path', hero_mp4_path, 'characters', characters)), '[]'::json) as ex from ttw.episodes

insert into ttw.episodes (platform, external_id, slug, title, description, published_at, thumbnail_url, video_url, characters) values ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6::timestamptz, nullif($7, ''), nullif($8, ''), case when jsonb_typeof($9::jsonb) = 'null' then null else array(select jsonb_array_elements_text($9::jsonb)) end) on conflict (platform, external_id) do update set title = excluded.title, description = excluded.description, published_at = excluded.published_at, video_url = excluded.video_url, characters = coalesce(ttw.episodes.characters, excluded.characters), thumbnail_url = case when ttw.episodes.platform = 'youtube' then excluded.thumbnail_url else ttw.episodes.thumbnail_url end returning id, platform, external_id, thumbnail_url, hero_mp4_path, (xmax = 0) as inserted

with u as (update ttw.episodes e set thumbnail_url = coalesce(x.thumb, e.thumbnail_url), hero_mp4_path = coalesce(x.hero, e.hero_mp4_path) from (select external_id, max(case when field = 'thumbnail_url' then value end) as thumb, max(case when field = 'hero_mp4_path' then value end) as hero from jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) as r(external_id text, field text, value text) group by external_id) x where e.platform = 'instagram' and e.external_id = x.external_id returning e.id) select count(*)::int as changed from u

select coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object('id', id, 'platform', platform, 'externalId', external_id, 'slug', slug, 'title', title, 'description', coalesce(description, ''), 'publishedAt', to_char(coalesce(published_at, created_at) at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"'), 'thumbnailUrl', coalesce(thumbnail_url, ''), 'videoUrl', coalesce(video_url, ''), 'heroMp4Path', hero_mp4_path, 'characters', coalesce(to_json(characters), '[]'::json)) order by coalesce(published_at, created_at) desc), '[]'::json) as j from ttw.episodes where not is_hidden
